text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! I'm so glad, they're in full 
bloom this year too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? This is my 
family's recommended flower-viewing spot!
choice_data_list: Yeah! It's such a beautiful place.
Yeah! It's such a beautiful place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, as the cherry blossom season 
arrived, I was invited by Sakura Chiyono O 
to enjoy flower viewing with her parents."

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for taking the trouble 
to come~. Even though it's such a busy 
time for both you and Chiyo, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, Trainer agreed with it too. They said, 
'Taking a break to refresh yourself is an 
important part of staying in shape.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...This park... We used to come here 
every year for cherry blossom viewing, 
didn't we? ...Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, here, please have this if 
you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the bento box were rapeseed greens 
tossed in sesame dressing and bamboo shoot 
rice. Taking a bite...
choice_data_list:
Delicious! It's like I'm tasting spring 
itself

Delicious! It's like I'm tasting spring 
itself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Looks like you really enjoyed 
Chiyono O's special 'Cherry Blossoms in 
Full Bloom Bento'!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Takes me back. Chiyo's homemade bento 
was always indispensable for our family's 
flower viewing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My big brothers and little sister praise 
it too! It's a boxed lunch my whole family 
is proud of. Eheh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I say, but getting it to taste 
this good was actually a ton of work."

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, it was quite an uproar~. 
The rice was still hard in the middle, and 
the rapeseed blossoms were undercooked!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: J-Jeez! You didn't have to say that~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I tried over and over, didn't I? 
Jotting down areas to improve in my 
Chiyo-Notebook...
choice_data_list: So that's why it turned out so delicious.
So that's why it turned out so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...♪ That's it, would you like me to 
teach you some tips on how to make it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everything about the "Cherry Blossoms in 
Full Bloom Bento" is written right here in 
my Chiyo-note!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying the cherry blossoms, I 
dropped by Sakura Chiyono O's family 
home...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, where's the Chiyo Notebook... Found 
it, found it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please wait a moment. I'll go look for my 
notebook from back then!
choice_data_list: What!? Are all of those Chiyo-notes...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've been writing them since I was 
little! Looking back at them now, there 
really are so many.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flipping through her notebook, round, 
childlike handwriting caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Chiyo Note
text_block_list.text:
"Upper body muscles are important for 
running fast!" "You won't grow tall if 
you're a picky eater!" "If you don't 
understand your studies, ask your 
friends!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Races, studies, relationships... Every 
page of the notebook was densely packed 
with notes on everything.
choice_data_list:
...You've really been putting in the 
small, steady efforts, haven't you?

...You've really stacked up all those 
little efforts, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, I'm just an ordinary 
Umamusume after all! If I don't put in the 
effort, I'll get left behind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This much is totally normal, completely 
normal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're exaggerating! This really isn't 
anything special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true. All those little efforts 
are sure to be her greatest weapons."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pure determination to do one's absolute 
best without faltering, even when 
confronted with overwhelming talent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“And the grit to reflect upon oneself, 
grow step by step, and eventually 
blossom.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer amount of effort she 
describes... is something no one else 
could ever replicate.
choice_data_list:
You need to have more faith in your own 
strengths!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then... is it really okay for me to stand 
tall and be proud of all these 
Chiyo-notes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how amazing everyone around 
me is, if I keep working steadily, do you 
think I can catch up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Understood! If that's what you say!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I think I'll let myself have just a 
little confidence... in all the hard work 
I've built up!"
